title: A normalized DVR tower
statement:
Use the global finite-field coefficient datum of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with residue characteristic $p$: fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and a scheme $X$. For $n\geq1$ write $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $B_n=(A_n)_X$ for the constant sheaf of rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and $R=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}=\varprojlim_n B_n$. For $m\geq n\geq1$ let $q_{m,n}:B_m\to B_n$ be induced by the quotient homomorphism and let $\pi_n:R\to B_n$ be the limit projection, so $q_{m,n}\pi_m=\pi_n$.

Write $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_n))$ and $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(R))$, with derived categories as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}$ and $\operatorname{Res}_n$ be restriction of scalars along $q_{m,n}$ and $\pi_n$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], applied termwise to complexes; restriction leaves the underlying abelian sheaf unchanged, so it preserves kernels and cokernels and induces derived functors by [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. Let $L_{m,n}=-\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n$ be derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The ordinary tensor-restriction adjunction sends a module map $f:N\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}P$ to $x\otimes b\mapsto b f(x)$, with inverse $g\mapsto(x\mapsto g(x\otimes1))$; balancing makes these inverse maps and they commute with restrictions. The notation 'adjoint' below uses $L_{m,n}\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}$, obtained from the usual tensor-restriction adjunction by [lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general]; restriction is exact and derived change of rings is everywhere defined.

A normalized DVR tower consists of objects $M_n\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ and transition morphisms
$$\tau_{m,n}:M_m\longrightarrow\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}M_n\qquad(m\geq n\geq1),$$
represented coherently in the derived tower category of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]: part of the datum is an object $\mathcal M_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}_R(X))$, with $\operatorname{Tow}_R(X)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(R))$ as defined for an arbitrary sheaf of rings in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], together with identifications $\operatorname{ev}_n\mathcal M_\bullet\cong\operatorname{Res}_nM_n$ under which its evaluated transition morphisms are $\operatorname{Res}_m(\tau_{m,n})$, using $\operatorname{Res}_m\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}=\operatorname{Res}_n$. Require $\tau_{n,n}=1$ and
$$\tau_{r,n}=\operatorname{Res}_{r,m}(\tau_{m,n})\circ\tau_{r,m}\qquad(r\geq m\geq n),$$
under the canonical identification of successive restrictions with restriction along the composite quotient map. For every $m\geq n$ the adjoint comparison
$$\alpha_{m,n}:M_m\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n\longrightarrow M_n$$
is required to be an isomorphism. The displayed identity and unit condition specify the quotient cocycle for the transitions (equivalently for their adjoints under the canonical iterated change-of-rings identifications). The tensor product is over the finite-level sheaf $B_m$, not over $R$.

No boundedness, constructibility, common stratification, or integral local model is part of this definition. Such finiteness and effectivity assertions must be proved separately.

proof.text: For the finite-restriction exactness helper, prove the general ring-sheaf case first in a private, fully proved lemma, retaining independent site, coefficient and module universes. The functors to abelian sheaves preserve finite limits by Mathlib and finite colimits by the existing source-library instance SheafOfModules.preservesFiniteColimits_toSheaf, the same instance used in moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful. These forgetful functors reflect isomorphisms.

Restriction followed by forgetting to abelian sheaves is definitionally the source forgetful functor. Thus both composites preserve finite limits and finite colimits. The target forgetful functor reflects both, by the Mathlib reflection instances for conservative functors preserving finite limits and colimits. Apply preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves and preservesFiniteColimits_of_reflects_of_preserves.

Specialize the private general lemma to normalizedDVRQuotient. The completed coefficient construction already provides abelian sheafification and its locally bijective characterization in the chosen module universe. All existing tower constructions and the universal Hom formulation of normalization remain unchanged.
